Application Data.NAME: John's Appliance Sales & Repair
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: John's Appliance Sales & Repair specializes in the retail sale and repair of household appliances, including refrigerators, washers, dryers, and microwaves. We operate primarily from our physical storefront, where we maintain a secure and well-organized inventory area valued under $500,000. Our business currently generates annual sales of approximately $400,000, with less than 20% of our revenue derived from installation and repair services conducted off-site. We prioritize customer satisfaction and adhere strictly to manufacturer installation guidelines and safety protocols. The location is equipped with a centrally monitored alarm system, and we conduct regular audits to ensure inventory integrity and compliance with safety standards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a customer reported damage to a refrigerator during repair services caused by an accidental water leak. The damage was assessed at $2,500, and the claim was settled promptly. On 05/20/2023, a claim was filed for a stolen microwave from the showroom, valued at $2,500. The incident was reported to the police, and the status is currently under investigation. Total losses to date amount to $5,000, with both claims now resolved.
